resources.string: Stops all vibration a game asks for: controller and trigger rumble, USB DualSense haptics, and this device vibrating in a controller\'s place.
In controller mouse mode, hold X while moving the stick to move the pointer a fixed number of pixels at a time. Press Y to double the step, from 1 up to 128 pixels and then back to 1.
The Back key on a physical keyboard sends the Windows key (Command on a Mac). Open the stream menu with Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M, Android\'s Back gesture or button, or the controller chord.
Right Alt sends the Windows key, which a Mac uses as Command, so Right Alt+C copies. Left Alt is unchanged. Leave off if you type characters with AltGr.
